Source: https://www.anthropic.com/news/introducing-claude-tag
- **Claude Sonnet 5 (June 30, 2026)** — new agentic model [REPORTED 2026-07-03, AIRT/ENDPOINT MEDIUM]. Model id `claude-sonnet-5`; plans, uses tools (browsers, terminals), runs autonomously near Opus 4.8. Via Claude API, AWS, Microsoft Foundry (Vertex soon); default for Free/Pro. New tokenizer. Source: https://www.anthropic.com/news/claude-sonnet-5
- **Claude Science AI Workbench (June 30, 2026)** — new app [REPORTED 2026-07-03, ENDPOINT/AIRT MEDIUM]. Research environment; builds environments, manages compute on laptop/cluster/on-demand GPUs; asks before reaching new resources; auditable artifacts. Source: https://www.anthropic.com/news/claude-science-ai-workbench
